, if an organization wants to develop a CoP, it should consider the following issues: (1) the importance of the community's power in its internal development and in the development of its environment, (2) the role of ideology in the community's internal and external development and (3) the importance of conflict in the internal development of the community., – Originality/value – This paper is original because it presents a new approach to the study of CoP theory.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CoP theory can be enriched in such a way as to account for power issues and their consequences on the development of a community of practice.
the development of communities of practice is not only a matter of internal empowerment and the development of social capital, but also a matter of power relations, ideology and conflict.
the development of a community is a complex process, which requires a favorable organizational context, as well as the empowerment of the community.
